 IRS Offers Continuing Education Credits Via Nationwide Tax Forum Online Seminars
 The IRS has launched its 2026 IRS Nationwide Tax Forum Online, an opportunity for tax professionals to access more than a dozen seminars recorded at this year's IRS Nationwide Tax Forum and earn continuing education credits.
 Jason Bramwell 
 The IRS has launched its 2026  IRS Nationwide Tax Forum Online , an opportunity for tax professionals to access more than a dozen seminars recorded at this year’s IRS Nationwide Tax Forum and earn continuing education credits.
 The IRS Nationwide Tax Forum Online provides information to tax professionals on current tax law, IRS procedures, and essential topics for the upcoming tax season. The seminars feature interactive video presentations synchronized with PowerPoint slides, downloadable resources, and full transcripts. 
 Twelve of the seminars are 50 minutes each; the other three seminars are 100 minutes each. Each 50-minute seminar offers one credit for a fee of $29 per credit. The 100-minute seminars are $58 each for two credits. Courses can also be audited for free.
 Frank Bisignano 
 “Tax professionals play a key role in the nation’s tax system by providing an important link between the Service and the taxpaying public, helping them understand their tax obligations,” IRS CEO Frank Bisignano said in a statement on Nov. 4. “As the IRS continues its transformation into a Digital-First agency, these updated seminars provide timely updates to help tax pros stay current and learn more about emerging areas of tax law.”
 To access the seminars, tax professionals need to log into or create an account on the  IRS Nationwide Tax Forum Online website. Instructions are available on the  Frequently Asked Questions tab.
 The  15 new 2026 seminars available now are:
 Beyond the Basics: Circular 230, Due Diligence, and Managing Professional Risk.
 Data Breaches: What Tax Professionals Need to Do and When to Do It (100 minutes).
 Digital Asset Information Reporting – What Practitioners Need to Know.
 How Much Do You Know About Refundable Credits?
 Managing IRS Collection Cases: Tools, Timing and Tactics.
 Navigating IRS Audits: Processes, Documentation and Digital Tools for Tax Professionals.
 New Capabilities for Business Tax Pros, Refund Status Email and More for IRS Online Accounts (100 minutes).
 Operating a Retirement Plan for the Do-It-Yourself Small Business Owner.
 Plenary Session: IRS Compliance, Filing Season and Technology Updates: A Conversation with IRS Leadership.
 Recent Updates in Retirement Plan Guidance – What You Need to Know.
 Recognizing Emerging Schemes: Real World Examples and Steps to Protect Your Firm.
 Resolving Disputes Effectively: The Power of ADR.
 Tax Law Changes, Saver’s Match and Other Key Updates for Tax Year 2026 (100 minutes).
 The Working Families Tax Cuts Act (“One Big Beautiful Bill”) Deductions for Tips, Overtime and Car Loan Interest: What’s Reported Where?
 Your License to Practice: Circular 230 and the Role of the Office of Professional Responsibility.
 The IRS Nationwide Tax Forum Online is registered with the IRS Tax Professional Management Office and the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy as an approved sponsor of continuing professional education for enrolled agents, CPAs, and Annual Filing Season Program participants.
